{"id":"vouch-xlha.4","title":"OSError and decode errors escape main as tracebacks","description":"main() in git-vouch (3220) and git-vouch-migrate (1122) catch only VouchError, but several I/O paths raise other exceptions unwrapped:

- git-vouch-migrate:559-560 (port: (out/'people').mkdir, write_bytes) and 969-971 (drafts: path.parent.mkdir, write_bytes): PermissionError/ENOSPC give a traceback. Worse, the --out directory is already created, so the retry is refused by the out.exists() guard (995, 1028) until the user deletes the partial directory by hand.
- git-vouch:2331-2358 _fetch (copy.mkdir, info/ mkdir, attributes write_text, vouch-url read_text/write_text, vouch-fetched touch), reached from cmd_sync/cmd_setup: an unwritable or full XDG_DATA_HOME gives a traceback.
- git-vouch:2302-2305 _fetched catches only FileNotFoundError around stat; PermissionError escapes.
- git-vouch:2290 _config and 2204 _output_path: proc.stdout.decode() strict; a non-UTF-8 git config value (path) raises UnicodeDecodeError.

Why it matters: users see a Python stack instead of 'git-vouch: error: ...', and for migrate a transient write failure leaves state that blocks the documented retry.

Fix: wrap these sites as the rest of the file does (except OSError as e: raise VouchError(...) from e); decode config with errors='surrogateescape' or wrap UnicodeDecodeError; in migrate, write drafts into a temp dir beside --out and rename it into place at the end, so a failure leaves no --out.","status":"open","priority":3,"issue_type":"task","owner":"mark@reviewcommit.com","created_at":"2026-10-23T19:23:13.324223231Z","created_by":"agent","updated_at":"2026-10-23T19:23:13.324223231Z","labels":["idiomatic-python","error-handling","review"],"dependencies":[{"issue_id":"vouch-xlha.4","depends_on_id":"vouch-xlha","type":"parent-child","created_at":"2026-10-23T19:23:13.351656349Z","created_by":"agent","metadata":"{}"}]}

new_value: git-vouch-migrate part: port and drafts write into a temp dir beside --out and rename it, failure gives 'git-vouch-migrate: error: OUT: cannot write the drafts' and leaves no --out, so retry works. Tests: test_port.py and test_drafts.py::test_failed_write_leaves_no_out_and_retry_works; mutation-checked. The git-vouch core sites listed in the description are owned by another unit.
